ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In a certain plant, hairy and hairless fruit peel, and yellow and white flesh, are two pairs of relative traits, each controlled by one pair of allelic genes (the former represented by D and d, the latter by F and f) and inherited independently. Three individuals of this plant species with different genotypes (hairy white-fleshed A, hairless yellow-fleshed B, hairless yellow-fleshed C) were used for crossing, and the experimental results are shown in the figure. Answer the question: If hairless yellow-fleshed B self-pollinates, theoretically, what is the ratio of hairless yellow-fleshed : hairless white-fleshed among the phenotypes of the next generation?

Three individuals of this plant species with different genotypes (hairy white-fleshed A, hairless yellow-fleshed B, hairless yellow-fleshed C) were used for crossing, and the experimental results are shown in the figure. Answer the question: If hairless yellow-fleshed B self-pollinates, theoretically, what is the ratio of hairless yellow-fleshed : hairless white-fleshed among the phenotypes of the next generation?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are three crossing experiments in the figure. Experiment 1 shows “hairy white-fleshed A × hairless yellow-fleshed B”, and the offspring are “hairy yellow-fleshed : hairy white-fleshed = 1:1”. Experiment 2 shows “hairless yellow-fleshed B × hairless yellow-fleshed C”, and the offspring are “all hairless yellow-fleshed”. Experiment 3 shows “hairy white-fleshed A × hairless yellow-fleshed C”, and the offspring are “all hairy yellow-fleshed”. Then reason: From Experiment 3, in which hairy white-fleshed A crossed with hairless yellow-fleshed C produces offspring all hairy yellow-fleshed, it can be determined that hairy is dominant over hairless, and yellow is dominant over white; therefore A should be DDff, and C should be ddFF. Combining Experiment 1, A is ff, and after crossing with B, flesh color yellow : white = 1:1, indicating that B is Ff for the flesh color gene. B itself is hairless, and hairless is recessive, so B’s fruit peel genotype is dd. Therefore B’s genotype is ddFf. B self-pollination is ddFf × ddFf; the offspring all have hairless fruit peel, and among flesh colors yellow : white = 3:1, so hairless yellow-fleshed : hairless white-fleshed = 3:1.
